cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: What Are We Now?
cards.instruction: Find out how someone defines the relationship without directly asking for a label.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Do I bring my own towel when I visit now? Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. The guest towel or the one that's always been mine?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yours is still on the hook. I haven't moved it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: When I leave, shall I hang it back there or put it with the guest laundry?

mechanism: A announces control of a visit while accommodating B household preferences through questions about whether A towel still has a permanent place.
confusable: Unlike an ordinary laundry query, the guest-versus-mine alternatives probe relationship definition; borrowed authority masks dependence as efficient housekeeping.
comparison: Private domestic permanence differs from public wedding-family inclusion.
seedUse: Use D78-b towel/hook/guest laundry and S02-b changing method while maintaining a capable voice.
